# gws recipe: Block focus time

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — the block-focus-time recipe: create recurring focus blocks on Google Calendar with a weekly RRULE and `transparency: opaque` so they show as busy, then verify with `+agenda`. Distinct from `googleworkspace-cli-recipe-schedule-recurring-event` (a recurring event WITH attendees) and `googleworkspace-cli-recipe-plan-weekly-schedule` (the weekly review ritual) in this lot: this one protects solo deep work — no participants, no meeting. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: requires the `gws` binary and a Google account (browser OAuth is free); install the prerequisite `googleworkspace-cli-gws-shared` first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
